digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep, Jira adapter transport layer
propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() and does not derive from an explicit declaration, risking undetected drift when a mutating method is renamed or moved outside the swept modules.
A classified mutating name exists outside the four swept transport modules only in backend.py (set_relationship, add_comment), both as pure same-name self.transport delegations.

An anti-drift assertion must scan all unswept adapters/jira/ modules and accept only pure delegating facades—a single return statement calling self.transport.<same_name> with arguments forwarded unchanged—rejecting any guard, retry, logging, or transform.
The four swept transport modules must be declared as an explicit named constant consumed by _step0_names() to make the sweep's scoping reviewable and prevent silent subject redefinition.
